The browser assets are copied from the exact npm releases in package-lock.json. Install those packages in a separate temporary directory with `npm ci --ignore-scripts`. Copy docx/dist/index.umd.cjs as docx-9.15.2/index.js, pdfmake/build/pdfmake.min.js and vfs_fonts.js as published, and @pdf-lib/fontkit/dist/fontkit.umd.min.js as fontkit-1.1.1/fontkit.js. Roboto-Regular.ttf is decoded from the published pdfmake virtual font file for glyph-coverage validation. All three packages use the MIT license. Dependency license texts are retained beside the vendor assets. These assets load only when exporting; no runtime dependency fetches a CDN.
